indexes._comment: The hot path: one department's courses, one term. Replaces an index on AdCollegeId+AdSectionId+AdTermId that matched no query in the code, because scoped reads resolve through the course catalogue rather than the denormalised fields.

The production database is Firestore Enterprise edition: nothing is indexed on its own, and a filter without an index reads the whole collection. None of the indexes in this file existed there until 2026-10-29, when they were created in the console; keep the two in step (tests/firestore-index-audit.ts checks the code against this file). This one: a term's rows — 15,185 queries in the week before, each reading all ~16,000 schedules (42.9M read units).
Rows of a few courses without a term (AdCourseId IN, and the delete guard's LIMIT 1): 30,321 + 1,428 + 749 queries in a week, each a full scan (~89M read units).
Live conflict check and the instructor's own timetable. The comment beside the query already assumed a single-field index — true in Standard edition, not in Enterprise.
Live conflict check and room occupancy: the same assumption as AdInstructorId.

The history list: one scope's versions, without their embedded snapshots. Its leading scopeKey serves the equality filter; since 2026-10-29 the query has no orderBy — sorting matching snapshots in memory failed at Firestore's 128 MiB query limit (RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED on /api/intelligence/versions and /api/schedules/wipe-scope), so newest-first and the limit are applied in Node.
Experience health: recent sparse client telemetry for one department.
ملاحظات قسمٍ في فصل، الأحدث أولاً. الترتيب عند قاعدة البيانات لا بعد القصّ: على هذه القائمة يُبنى عدُّ الملاحظات الذي يمنع إرسال الجدول ويسمح به.
ملاحظات الفصل كله لصندوق وارد التسجيل: قراءةٌ واحدة تُوزَّع على الأقسام، بدل رحلةٍ لكل قسم في كل فتحةِ شاشة.
A department's courses: 77,420 queries in a week, each reading the whole catalogue (~4,500 documents, 21.8M read units).
Hydrating a handful of rows to their courses (AdCourseId IN), and the catalogue in course order.
A department's study-plan courses: 177,656 queries in a week, each reading all ~5,800 plan courses (85.3M read units).
A department's study plans: 409,717 queries in a week — the most frequent query in the app — each reading every plan (17.9M read units).
A signed-in user's permissions, read with every session: 14,197 queries a week, ~420 documents read to return 6.
A signed-in user's scopes, read beside formSecurity: ~440 documents read to return 3.
A department's open draft: 693 queries a week, 85 documents read to return 2, each draft carrying its rows (3.2M read units).
A term's instructor requests: 10,465 queries a week (1.3M read units).
Opening a request link: one document, found without reading the others.
The audit log's newest thousand: 24,505 documents read per view without it.
«👣 الأثر»: a team's moves in one term, newest first (src/utils/activityTrail.ts). One indexed question per team per term, limited — never the whole collection.
«👣 الأثر»: one person's moves in one term — a member sees only their own, the dean only department heads.
«👣 الأثر»: the system administrator's view of a whole term, newest first and limited.
«👣 الأثر»: the «آخر تعديل» stamp on one appointment — the newest move on that row, limit 1.

fieldOverrides._comment: Expired sessions delete themselves. Every abandoned browser used to leave a document that lived forever, because cleanup only happened if someone presented the expired session again.
Operational telemetry expires automatically; it is for recent diagnostics, not permanent tracking.
